name: io.gantlett/seam-governance
title: Gantlett Systems - AI Governance Seam Pilots & Executive Briefs
description: Scope 14-day AI governance seam pilots, brownfield executive briefs, and SLSA/SARIF compliance.

tools.name: inspect_seam_pilot_scope
tools.description: Inspect the fixed-fee 14-Day AI Governance & Seam Charter Pilot deliverables, Step-0 nomos xray diagnostic, milestone schedule, and sector failure locks. Example: sector='regulated' returns regulated-industry seam locks and pricing. Use when evaluating commercial pilot pricing, timeline, or deliverables. Do NOT use when searching technical whitepapers (use search_executive_briefings instead) or regulatory framework mappings (use inspect_compliance_and_sovereign_posture instead).

sector.description: Optional industry sector filter for failure-mode locks.

tools.name: search_executive_briefings
tools.description: Search Gantlett Systems Inc. Executive Architecture Briefings covering brownfield AI velocity, zero-ASR agent containment, and sovereign local GPU economics. Example: query='brownfield' returns matching CTO briefings. Use when retrieving CTO/VP Engineering executive briefings by topic. Do NOT use when checking fixed-fee 14-Day Seam Pilot commercial terms (use inspect_seam_pilot_scope instead).

query.description: Optional briefing keyword filter (returns all briefings when omitted).

tools.name: inspect_compliance_and_sovereign_posture
tools.description: Inspect signed SLSA v1.0 DSSE provenance, OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 Code Scanning, seam-dossier regulatory mappings (SOC2 CC8.1, NIS2, EU AI Act, NIST CAISI), and air-gapped Sovereign GPU deployment architecture. Example: framework='SOC2' returns SOC2 CC8.1 provenance controls. Use when answering CISO, audit, provenance, or air-gapped hosting questions. Do NOT use when inspecting pilot schedule or fee bands (use inspect_seam_pilot_scope instead).

framework.description: Optional compliance standard or provenance capability filter.
